apisNote: Regenerated 9 September 2026 from B2B, Reseller & OTA Partner Management_Reference.pdf page 56. 4 of 4 labels bound to a contract property; 27 of 45 pack bullets carried onto the screen — the rest are acceptance prose, worked examples and AI narrative, which belong to the matrix and the contracts rather than here.

overlays.body: **Collects what `createPartnerCase` sends before it is called.** The person picks the **case type** (booking dispute, pricing dispute, credit dispute, ticket issue, allocation issue, API issue) and the priority, describes it and links the order, invoice or settlement batch; `partnerId` comes from the session; the owner, SLA policy, resolution target and response times are the server's. Never `id` or `status`: an id is a client UUIDv7 generated silently and the status and timestamps are the server's (design-notes correction, CHG-SOT-015). Dismissing sends nothing; the screen behind is unchanged.

**Collects what `actOnPartnerCase` sends before it is called.** Required: `action`. Optional: `ownerPrincipalId`, `resolution`, `reason`, `note`. Dismissing sends nothing; the screen behind is unchanged.
